# Theme reference

Reference of theme contract v1, generated from the code. To change it, change the contract and run `npm run theme:reference`; `npm run lint` fails when these files are out of date. How to build a theme: [../creating-a-theme.md](../creating-a-theme.md); the decision: [ADR 0005](../../adr/0005-theme-contract.md).

- [Roles](roles.md): every role of `theme.json`, its purpose, default and contrast rules, and the type scale.
- [Layout](layout.md): regions and their variants.
- [Hooks](hooks.md): the `bd-*` classes and `data-*` attributes a theme may style.
- [Slots](slots.md): the components a theme may replace, with their props and defaults.
